title: Runtime capabilities (ADR 0065)
description: Optional `capabilities` of GET /runtime/v1/status. The web hosts (Vercel, the node runtime) never send it, so the web app keeps its current behaviour. The desktop host sends it.

loop.description: server: POST /runtime/v1/run runs the agent turn. client: the app runs the turn itself and the host forwards provider calls with its key (POST /runtime/v1/xai/*).

files.description: The host keeps generated pictures and serves them at /runtime/v1/files/<sha256>.<ext>.

saveFile.description: The host saves a file through a native dialog (POST /runtime/v1/export).

signIn.description: Sign-in methods the host offers (ADR 0067): openrouter is the OAuth PKCE sign-in at POST /runtime/v1/auth/openrouter/start. The app shows a sign-in control only for a method listed here.
